how_to_apply: Forward application in prescribed format available on website www.ddd.gov.in.
Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualification, registration certificate, experience certificate, and other relevant documents.

Submit the application to the Member Secretary (GB), Rogi Kalyan Samiti, Govt. Hospital, Daman Office of the Medical Superintendent, NAMO. Hospital, Daman, Nani Daman - 396210 on or before 24.10.2026 by 12:00 PM.
Applications may also be sent via email to [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview. Application will be summarily rejected if found deviant from prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS/BDS degree or a graduate degree with an MBA in Hospital Administration/Healthcare Management (full-time two-year course). Experience: Minimum three years of experience in healthcare/hospital management. Other conditions: Proficiency in English, computer literacy and knowledge of applicable government legislation and policies. Candidates holding Domicile Certificate of Daman & Diu will be given preference. Desirable: Training and experience in the implementation of JCI/NABH/NQAS accreditation or certification requirements in recognized hospitals. Two letters of recommendation from previously employed institutions.
